title: Sarana Dashboard & Point of Sales System
description: A bilingual POS and dashboard I built for my family's shop in Indonesia to manage sales, stock, and orders.

body.raw:
![Sarana dashboard overview](/img/sarana/1.jpg)
![Point of Sales screen](/img/sarana/2.jpg)

> Sarana is the POS and dashboard I built for my family's shop. It helps with the everyday jobs: sales, stock, and orders, in Indonesian or English.

---

## 🚀 Try the App

- 👉 [Visit the App](https://sarana-dashboard.vercel.app/)
- 💻 [View Code on GitHub](https://github.com/applescan/Sarana-Dashboard)

---

## 🧠 Why This Project?

The previous POS setup was slow and cluttered. I made Sarana around the tasks my parents actually need, without adding a pile of features they don't.

---

## 🪄 Unique Touches

- 🇮🇩 **Bilingual Interface** (Indonesian & English)
- 🎯 Custom features tuned to my family's actual workflows
- 🔄 Simplified experience that doesn't overwhelm

---

## 🔐 Key Features

### 📊 Dashboard

- **Real-Time Insights**: Monitor sales, stock, and revenue instantly 🔍
- **AI-Powered Trends**: Built-in OpenAI support for smarter decisions 🤖

### 📦 Product Management

- Powerful **search & filter** tools 🕵️‍♂️
- Instant **stock tracking** 📦
- Easy **admin editing** ✏️

### 📃 Order Management

- Browse by date or keyword 📅
- Modify orders without friction 🧑‍💼
- **Mark as Received** to auto-update stock ✅

---

## ✨ Bonus!

This version uses a test database — so if you see a 404, it's likely the free Supabase tier limit was reached 😅
Still, feel free to explore and let me know what you think!

---

## 🛠 Built With

- Next.js
- Prisma
- Clerk (Auth)
- Tailwind CSS + ShadCN
- GraphQL + Apollo
- OpenAI (AI Insights)
- Supabase (DB)
- Echarts
- TypeScript
- Canva / Figma

---
